import asyncio, hashlib, inspect, json, pathlib, tempfile, time
from unittest.mock import patch
from mini_loop.background import BackgroundManager
from mini_loop import background
out=pathlib.Path('/tmp/mini-loop-timing-diagnosis-2026-10-12')
cases=[('normal-expired',0,'sleep 1.1; printf options-done'),('delayed-ledger-expired',0.25,'sleep 1.1; printf options-done'),('delayed-ledger-finished',1.25,'sleep 1.1; printf options-done'),('quick-completion',0,'sleep 0.03; printf options-done')]
async def capture():
 rows=[]
 for name, delay, command in cases:
  with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='mini-loop-background-timing-') as tmp:
   manager=BackgroundManager(pathlib.Path(tmp));events=[];began=time.monotonic()
   original_ledger=manager._write_ledger;original_wait=asyncio.wait_for;original_read=manager._bounded_read;original_kill=background._kill_group
   def event(stage): events.append({'seconds':time.monotonic()-began,'stage':stage})
   def ledger(bg_id,command,*,pid):
    if pid is not None: event('spawn-return');time.sleep(delay)
    result=original_ledger(bg_id,command,pid=pid)
    if pid is not None:event('observer-return')
    return result
   async def wait(awaitable,timeout):
    event('timer-ready')
    try:
     result=await original_wait(awaitable,timeout)
     event('wait-return');return result
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
     event('deadline-received');raise
   async def read(*args):
    result=await original_read(*args);event('drained');return result
   def kill(proc):event('kill-group');original_kill(proc)
   with patch.object(manager,'_write_ledger',ledger),patch.object(manager,'_bounded_read',read),patch.object(asyncio,'wait_for',wait),patch.object(background,'_kill_group',kill):
    manager.run(command,timeout=True)
    await manager._tasks['bg_0001']['handle']
   row=manager._tasks['bg_0001'];rows.append({'name':name,'delay_ms':round(delay*1000),'status':row['status'],'result':row['result'],'events':events})
   await manager.close()
 return rows
receipt={'diagnostic_only':True,'acceptance':False,'original_failure_retained':True,'delays_are_injected_after_spawn':True,'cases':asyncio.run(capture()),'source_sha256':{name:hashlib.sha256(inspect.getsource(fn).encode()).hexdigest() for name,fn in [('BackgroundManager._exec',BackgroundManager._exec),('BackgroundManager._write_ledger',BackgroundManager._write_ledger),('asyncio.wait_for',asyncio.wait_for)]}}
(out/'source-background-timing.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
for row in receipt['cases']: print(row['name'],row['status'],row['result'])
diagnostic_sources.profile_forty_turns.py:
import asyncio, cProfile, hashlib, json, pathlib, pstats, tempfile, time
from mini_loop import SessionManager, Settings
from mini_loop.fake_llm import FakeAsyncAnthropic, text, tool
root = pathlib.Path('/Users/yanjixiong/github/mini-loop')
out = pathlib.Path('/tmp/mini-loop-timing-diagnosis-2026-10-12')
turns = {'n': 0}
def responder(request):
    turns['n'] += 1
    if turns['n'] % 2:
        return ([tool('run_bash', _id=f"t{turns['n']}", command='echo hi')], 'tool_use')
    return ([text('X' * 3000)], 'end_turn')
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='mini-loop-cost-diagnostic-') as tmp:
    manager = SessionManager(Settings(fake_llm=True, workspace_root=pathlib.Path(tmp)/'ws', skills_dir=root/'python/skills'), FakeAsyncAnthropic(responder=responder))
    session = manager.create()
    async def workload():
        for index in range(40):
            await session.agent.run(f'turn {index}')
    profiler=cProfile.Profile()
    began=time.monotonic()
    profiler.enable()
    asyncio.run(workload())
    profiler.disable()
    elapsed=time.monotonic()-began
    profiler.dump_stats(str(out/'forty-turns.pstats'))
    with (out/'forty-turns-profile.txt').open('w') as stream:
        pstats.Stats(profiler, stream=stream).strip_dirs().sort_stats('cumtime').print_stats(45)
    receipt={'diagnostic_only':True,'acceptance':False,'original_failure_retained':True,'turns':40,'model_calls':turns['n'],'profiled_elapsed_seconds':elapsed,'source_test_sha256':hashlib.sha256((root/'python/tests/test_double_cost.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
    (out/'forty-turns-profile.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(receipt)
